name: unlimdesk
description: Unofficial desktop client for Unlim Cloud, built with Electron.
author: Nullmess

scripts.setup-linux: node -e "if(process.platform!=='linux'){console.log('Linux only.');process.exit(0)}const fs=require('fs'),cp=require('child_process'),path=require('path');const s=path.join(process.cwd(),'node_modules/electron/dist/chrome-sandbox');if(!fs.existsSync(s)){console.error('Run npm install first.');process.exit(1)}cp.execFileSync('sudo',['chown','root:root',s],{stdio:'inherit'});cp.execFileSync('sudo',['chmod','4755',s],{stdio:'inherit'});console.log('Sandbox helper configured.')"
scripts.clean: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const targets=['node_modules',...fs.readdirSync('.').filter(n=>/^UnlimDesk-(win32|linux|darwin)-/.test(n))];for(const p of targets)fs.rmSync(p,{recursive:true,force:true});console.log('Dependencies and build outputs removed.')"
scripts.build-all: npm run build-win && npm run build-mac && npm run build-lin
